sentences.ar: SQL مش بتشتغل بالترتيب اللي إنت كاتبها بيه.
sentences.en: SQL does not run in the order you write it.

sentences.ar: بصّ. FROM الأول، لأن المحرك محتاج صفوف قبل ما يعمل أي حاجة.
sentences.en: Watch. FROM first, because the engine needs rows before it can do anything.

sentences.ar: بعدها JOIN، وهنا عدد الصفوف ممكن ينفجر أو ينهار.
sentences.en: Then JOIN, and this is where the number of rows can explode or collapse.

sentences.ar: بعدها WHERE وده أرخص مكسب في اللغة كلها، لأن كل صف بيتشال دلوقتي هو صف الـgrouping عمره ما هيلمسه.
sentences.en: Then WHERE — and this is your cheapest win in the entire language, because every row eliminated now is a row the grouping never touches.

sentences.ar: بعدها GROUP BY، والصفوف بتنهار لصف واحد لكل group.
sentences.en: Then GROUP BY, where rows collapse into one per group.

sentences.ar: ودلوقتي بس SELECT بتشتغل، ودلوقتي بس الـalias اسمه revenue بيتولد وده بالظبط سبب إن WHERE ما قدرتش تستخدمه وORDER BY تقدر.
sentences.en: Only now does SELECT run, and only now does the alias revenue come into existence — which is precisely why WHERE could not use it and ORDER BY can.

sentences.ar: بعدها DISTINCT، بعدها ORDER BY، وLIMIT آخر واحدة خالص.
sentences.en: Then DISTINCT, then ORDER BY, and LIMIT absolutely last.

sentences.ar: بصّ على الـfunnel: أربعتاشر صف داخلين، تلتاشر بعد ما الـjoin شال الصف اليتيم، حداشر بعد الفلتر، وgroupين خارجين gold وsilver
sentences.en: Watch the funnel: fourteen rows in, thirteen after the join drops the orphan, eleven after the filter, two groups out — gold and silver

sentences.ar: واجمعهم: تلات آلاف وتسعميّة تمانية وأربعين ونص، نفس الإجمالي اللي شابتر التنضيف هيوصله من الناحية التانية.
sentences.en: And add them up: three thousand nine hundred and forty-eight fifty, the same total the cleaning chapter will reach from the other direction.

sentences.ar: ودلوقتي السؤال اللي بيسقّط مرشحين أكتر من أي syntax error.
sentences.en: Now the question that gets more candidates rejected than any syntax error.

sentences.ar: قبل ما تكتب سطر واحد، جاوب: صف واحد لكل إيه؟
sentences.en: Before you write a single line, answer this: one row per what?

sentences.ar: لكل order؟ لكل customer؟ لكل customer في اليوم؟
sentences.en: One per order, one per customer, one per customer per day?

sentences.ar: أغلب الـdashboards البايظة مش syntax بايظ.
sentences.en: Most broken dashboards are not broken syntax.

sentences.ar: دي SUM اتحسبت على grain غلط، فطلعت رقم واثق جداً بس هو ببساطة مش إجابة السؤال اللي اتسأل.
sentences.en: They are a SUM computed at the wrong grain, which returns a perfectly confident number that is simply not the answer to the question that was asked.
And LIMIT 1 — did the engine save any work?

sentences.ar: لأ، هو لسه اضطر ينتج ويرتب كل الـgroups عشان يعرف مين اللي كسب.
sentences.en: It still had to produce and sort every group to know which one wins.

glossary.rule: Explain the term in Egyptian Arabic the first time it appears; then use the original term naturally, in Latin script, inside Arabic sentences.
glossary.register_ar: Natural Egyptian, clear, calm, professional. Use إحنا and خلّينا نشوف and ببساطة where they help. No heavy Modern Standard Arabic. No exaggerated slang. Numbers are spoken naturally in Egyptian but displayed as Western digits.
glossary.register_en: Plain, direct, unhurried. Short sentences. No hype, no "imagine that…", no rhetorical questions that are not real prediction prompts. Say the number, then pause for half a beat before the next sentence — the pause is where the viewer reads the screen.
glossary.never_translate_rule: Explain them in Egyptian Arabic the first time they appear, then use the original term naturally.
glossary.on_screen: Western digits, Latin terms in LTR isolates, Egyptian Arabic copy (no MSA), no per-letter animation (04 section 3.4).

concepts.def_en: Structured Query Language: the standard declarative language for querying and changing da…
concepts.failure: Thinking SQL runs in written order; the engine plans execution in its own order.

concepts.def_en: Combines rows from two tables by matching key columns, such as orders with their customer…
concepts.failure: Joining on a non-unique key silently multiplies rows and inflates totals.

concepts.def_en: SQL clause that splits rows into groups sharing the same key values, so aggregates like SUM or COUNT run once per group.
concepts.def_ar: جزء في SQL بيقسم الصفوف لمجموعات ليها نفس قيم الـkey، فالـaggregates زي SUM وCOUNT بتشتغل مرة لكل مجموعة.
concepts.failure: Grouping on a dirty key, so one customer splits into many groups.

concepts.def_en: The clause that filters groups after GROUP BY, using aggregate results such as SUM or COUNT.
concepts.def_ar: الـclause اللي بتفلتر الـgroups بعد GROUP BY، باستخدام نتايج الـaggregate زي SUM وCOUNT.
concepts.failure: Filtering an aggregate like SUM in WHERE, which runs before grouping.

concepts.def_en: The SQL clause that chooses which columns or expressions to return, and where aliases are…
concepts.failure: Writing SELECT * in production, pulling columns and resources nobody needs.

concepts.def_en: The SQL clause that sorts result rows by one or more columns; it runs after SELECT, so it can use column aliases.
concepts.def_ar: الـORDER BY clause في SQL بترتّب صفوف النتيجة حسب عمود أو أكتر؛ بتتنفذ بعد الـSELECT فتقدر تستخدم الـaliases.
concepts.failure: Expecting a stable row order without ORDER BY; SQL guarantees none.

concepts.def_en: SQL keyword that removes duplicate rows from a result, running after SELECT and before ORDER BY.
concepts.def_ar: كلمة في SQL بتشيل الصفوف المكررة من النتيجة، وبتتنفذ بعد SELECT وقبل ORDER BY.
concepts.failure: Using DISTINCT to hide duplicates caused by a faulty join.

concepts.def_en: SQL clause that caps how many rows a query returns; it runs last, so pair it with ORDER B…
concepts.failure: Using LIMIT without ORDER BY, so which rows come back is arbitrary.

concepts.def_en: A stage-by-stage view in which rows shrink at each step, such as join, filter and group,…
concepts.failure: Not counting rows at each stage, so a join silently dropping rows goes unnoticed.

concepts.def_en: A message or failure signalling that something went wrong; read it first, since it usuall…
concepts.failure: Pasting the error into a search engine without first reading the terminal output.

concepts.def_en: What exactly one row represents, such as one order line; every metric must be computed at…
concepts.failure: Computing a SUM at the wrong grain, getting a confident but wrong number.
